facts.fact: Raxio Group inaugurated Raxio DRC1 in Limete, Kinshasa on 22 August 2024: 1,542 m2, up to 400 racks, 1.5 MW, colocation and connectivity, carrier-neutral.
Raxio DRC1 in Kinshasa has Tier III accreditation from the Uptime Institute, stated in the operator's 22 August 2024 press release.
